_comment: Project Horizon headquarters campaign - the single curated source for the six commissioning stages.
Read by scripts/gen_headquarters.py (advancements, recipes, service loot, server data, docs/HEADQUARTERS.md),
scripts/gen_assets.py (items, blocks, textures, lang) and scripts/gen_quests.py (the '0 - Headquarters Campaign' spine).
Authority: kubejs/server_scripts/horizon_headquarters.js keeps the canonical ledger on the server; every horizon:hq/*
advancement and quest is a mirror of that ledger and never a way to earn a stage.
Stable ids: stage/option/requirement/service ids below are save data. Rename the title, never the id.

premise: Long before the villages, a frontier survey company strung a line of observatories across the continent: the Lantern Line.
Each station watched one horizon and sent what it saw to the next. The line went dark, the stations fell, and the maps were scattered.
You carry the last charter of the Meridian Survey. Plant it anywhere, restore a station around it, and relight the line one horizon at a time.
fiction.symbol: a turquoise survey chevron over a copper meridian ring

receipts.horizon:survey_blank: Crafted. Only becomes a Survey Plate under a Create Mechanical Press.
receipts.horizon:survey_plate: Exists only as the output of create:pressing horizon:survey_blank - proof that a press line ran.
receipts.create:precision_mechanism: Create sequenced assembly output (rarely found in loot) - proof of a working assembly line.
receipts.mekanism:enriched_iron: Output of Mekanism's Enrichment Chamber - proof that a powered processing machine ran.
receipts.powah:steel_energized: Output of Powah's Energizing Orb - proof that a powered orb ran.
receipts.modern_industrialization:steel_ingot: Produced by MI steam/electric blast furnaces (Mekanism makes a different steel id).

stages.title: Outpost
stages.summary: Plant the charter, sleep at home, store what you find, set up a survey table and walk to the nearest ruin.
stages.log: Station founded. The charter is planted, a bed is made and the first map table is cold but level. Somewhere close there is a ruin; the old line always passed near one.
stages.why: A home you respawn at, storage you trust, and a first lead pointing away from it.

requirements.text: Sleep in a bed within 24 blocks of the charter
requirements.proves: The commissioning player's respawn point is set within 24 blocks of the anchor.

requirements.text: Place 2 chests or barrels near the charter
requirements.proves: Two storage blocks stand within the scan volume around the anchor at commissioning time.

requirements.text: Place a cartography table (the survey station)
requirements.proves: A cartography table stands within the scan volume.

requirements.text: Plant a crop or breed animals (reliable food)
requirements.proves: A member holds a vanilla husbandry advancement.

requirements.text: Step inside any roadside ruin, camp or settlement
requirements.proves: A member has stood inside a structure of the roadside or settlement family (location advancement).

stages.unlocks: A copper Construction Stick, a timber-and-stone building kit and a Surveyor's Chart to the nearest temple or arcane site.
stages.next: Workshop: press your first Survey Plates on a Create line.

stages.title: Workshop
stages.summary: Run a Create press line, press Survey Plates, add a construction station and bring back a find from a dungeon, temple or wreck.
stages.log: The press is turning. The first plates came off it true enough to survey with, and the station can build for itself again.
stages.why: Production at home: better building reach, a supply crate every day and real processing instead of hand crafting.

requirements.text: Make sheets with a Mechanical Press
requirements.proves: Create's builtin trigger fires only when a press actually produces sheets (not on crafting or placing).

requirements.text: A Mechanical Press stands at the station
requirements.proves: A press is within the scan volume.

requirements.text: A depot, basin or belt feeds the press
requirements.proves: A feed block is within the scan volume.

requirements.text: Place a schematic table or crafting table (construction station)
requirements.proves: A construction workstation is within the scan volume.

requirements.text: Enter a dungeon, temple, ocean ruin or arcane site
requirements.proves: A member stood inside one of four common structure families.

stages.unlocks: An iron Construction Stick, Create's schematic tools, a millstone and fan for ore processing, and the daily Supply Crate service.
stages.next: Expedition Hall: prepare for, and finish, two of three regional expeditions.

stages.title: Expedition Hall
stages.summary: Furnish an equipment bench, an archive lectern and a discovery display, then finish two of three regional expeditions.
stages.log: The hall is open. The archive holds what the line knew about two regions, and the cases already hold something the old surveyors never saw.
stages.why: Each region you finish permanently adds its own charts to the station's survey desk.

requirements.text: An equipment bench: smithing table, anvil or grindstone
requirements.proves: An equipment workstation is within the scan volume.

requirements.text: An archive: a lectern or chiseled bookshelf
requirements.proves: An archive block is within the scan volume.

requirements.text: A Discovery Case or any boss trophy on display
requirements.proves: A Horizon display block is within the scan volume.

choices.title: Regional expeditions
choices.text: Finish any two. The third stays open as an optional adventure and still adds its charts later.

options.title: The Drowned Coast
options.summary: Wrecks, sunken ruins and monuments. Bring a boat, Respiration and night vision.

requirements.text: Enter an ocean structure
requirements.proves: Location advancement for the ocean family.

options.contribution: Tide charts: the survey desk can draw maps to ocean ruins and monuments.

options.title: The Hollow Roads
options.summary: Crypts, mines and mage towers under and around the hills. Bring a shield, torches and magic resistance.

requirements.text: Enter an underground dungeon
requirements.proves: Location advancement for the underground family.

requirements.text: Enter an arcane site
requirements.proves: Location advancement for the arcane family.

options.contribution: Archive charts: the survey desk can draw maps to temples and arcane sites.

options.title: The High Landmarks
options.summary: Great landmarks and the mini-bosses that keep them. Bring rare gear, healing and a way home.

requirements.text: Enter a great landmark
requirements.proves: Location advancement for the landmark family.

requirements.text: Defeat any landmark mini-boss
requirements.proves: A member holds a first-kill legend advancement (relics from it stay personal).

options.contribution: Landmark charts: the survey desk can draw maps to great landmarks.

stages.unlocks: Warp scrolls and expedition gear; the survey desk keeps every regional chart you have contributed.
stages.next: Arcane Conservatory: commission one research room with Ars Nouveau, Iron's Spells or Occultism.

stages.title: Arcane Conservatory
stages.summary: Commission one research or ritual room - Ars Nouveau, Iron's Spells or Occultism - and feed it an Ancient Core.
stages.log: The conservatory hums. Whatever the old surveyors used to see past the weather, we have something like it again.
stages.why: Expedition protection (the Ward of Passage) and the deep survey of boss lairs.

choices.title: Research route
choices.text: Any one route commissions the room; the others stay full side paths with their own rewards.

options.title: Source Study (Ars Nouveau)
options.summary: Utility magic and automation: an Enchanting Apparatus at the station.

requirements.text: Craft an Enchanting Apparatus
requirements.proves: Ars Nouveau's advancement for the apparatus.

requirements.text: The apparatus stands at the station
requirements.proves: Apparatus within the scan volume.

options.contribution: Source studies on the archive shelves.

options.title: Spell Forge (Iron's Spells)
options.summary: Combat magic: an Arcane Anvil and an Inscription Table at the station.

requirements.text: Craft an Arcane Anvil
requirements.proves: Iron's Spells advancement for the anvil.

requirements.text: Arcane Anvil and Inscription Table at the station
requirements.proves: Two Iron's workstations within the scan volume.

options.contribution: Inscription records on the archive shelves.

options.title: Spirit Circle (Occultism)
options.summary: Spirits and rituals: a golden sacrificial bowl and a working summoning.

requirements.text: Complete a spirit summoning ritual
requirements.proves: Occultism ritual advancements fire on a completed ritual.

requirements.text: A golden sacrificial bowl at the station
requirements.proves: Bowl within the scan volume.

options.contribution: Spirit ledgers on the archive shelves.

stages.unlocks: The Ward of Passage (resistance and fire safety for an expedition, once per day per member) and lair charts to boss arenas.
stages.next: Foundry and Logistics: power, assembly and networked storage.

stages.title: Foundry and Logistics
stages.summary: Assemble precision mechanisms, run one electrical processing route and network your storage.
stages.log: The foundry is lit. The station feeds itself now; the survey crews carry what they need and bring back only what matters.
stages.why: Automated supplies, a better construction stick and the logistics the observatory will depend on.

requirements.text: Assemble a Precision Mechanism (Create sequenced assembly)
requirements.proves: Create's advancement for holding a precision mechanism; the cost below consumes two.

requirements.text: A storage network controller at the station (AE2, Sophisticated Storage or Occultism)
requirements.proves: A storage controller block within the scan volume.

choices.title: Primary electrical route
choices.text: Pick one. The checklists are equivalent, so you never build a duplicate factory to finish the stage.

options.title: Mekanism processing
options.summary: Ore multiplication and chemistry. Enriched iron proves the chamber ran.

requirements.text: Build an Enrichment Chamber
requirements.proves: Mekanism's advancement for the chamber.

options.contribution: Ore doubling for the station's supply lines.

options.title: Modern Industrialization
options.summary: Multiblock heavy industry. The Electric Blast Furnace is the gate.

requirements.text: Build the Electric Blast Furnace
requirements.proves: MI's advancement for the multiblock.

options.contribution: Steel and alloys for the observatory frame.

options.title: Powah energizing
options.summary: Simple, scalable generators. Energized steel proves the orb ran.

requirements.text: An Energizing Orb at the station
requirements.proves: Orb within the scan volume (Powah ships no advancements).

options.contribution: A clean power trunk for the station.

stages.unlocks: A diamond Construction Stick with the replacement template, mechanical crafters, and a larger daily Supply Crate.
stages.next: Observatory: build the lens, walk three realms, defeat two great legends and pass a Horizon Trial.

stages.title: Observatory and Horizon Beacon
stages.summary: Set an Observatory Lens at the station, chart three realms, defeat two great legends and pass one Horizon Trial.
stages.log: The lens is set and the beacon is lit. Far off, on the last ridge we can see, another light answers. The Lantern Line is open.
stages.why: The capstone: the Horizon Beacon, the full survey desk and the post-campaign Gauntlet.

requirements.text: An Observatory Lens placed at the station
requirements.proves: The lens block (one Starforged Heart, crafted once) is within the scan volume.

requirements.text: Members have entered 3 of 7 realms (Nether, Aether, Undergarden, Otherside, End, Bumblezone, Moon)
requirements.proves: Dimension-entry advancements, any three, across headquarters members.

requirements.text: Members have defeated 2 great legends (any)
requirements.proves: First-kill legend advancements; hearts and trophies stay with whoever earned them.

requirements.text: Pass one Horizon Trial (Tides, Cinders or Void) at a Gateway
requirements.proves: Trial advancement granted on Gateways completion near the gate.

stages.unlocks: The Horizon Beacon (a light the whole valley can see), the explorer's hat, and full survey charts. Post-campaign: the Horizon Gauntlet.
stages.next: Beyond the line: every legend, every realm, and the Horizon Gauntlet.

supply_crate.title: Supply Crate
supply_crate.text: Once per day the station packs rations, torches and rope for one expedition.

supply_crate_plus.title: Foundry Supply Crate
supply_crate_plus.text: The foundry's crate: more food, building stock and processed metals. Never relics.

survey_ocean.title: Tide Chart
survey_ocean.text: A map to an ocean ruin or monument.

survey_archive.title: Archive Chart
survey_archive.text: A map to a temple or arcane site.

survey_landmark.title: Landmark Chart
survey_landmark.text: A map to a great landmark.

survey_lair.title: Lair Chart
survey_lair.text: A map to a boss arena.

survey_horizon.title: Horizon Chart
survey_horizon.text: The observatory's chart: a landmark, lair or ocean site at random.

ward.title: Ward of Passage
ward.text: Five minutes of Resistance I and Fire Resistance for the road. No invulnerability.

horizon:survey_charter.name: Meridian Survey Charter
tip: Right-click: headquarters panel. Plant it where your base will grow.
Breaking it never erases progress; place it again to relocate.

horizon:discovery_case.name: Discovery Case
tip: Displays a discovery in the Expedition Hall.
Counts as the hall's display, like any boss trophy.

horizon:observatory_lens.name: Observatory Lens
tip: The Observatory's great lens. Crafted once, from a Starforged Heart.
Must stand at the station to commission stage VI.

horizon:horizon_beacon.name: Horizon Beacon
tip: The relit Lantern Line. Awarded once per headquarters.
Purely a light and a landmark; it does nothing else.

horizon:founding_kit.name: Founding Kit
tip: Right-click to unpack: a Survey Charter and a few supplies.
Given once to each new player.

horizon:survey_blank.name: Survey Blank
tip: Press it under a Create Mechanical Press.
The Workshop needs pressed plates, not blanks.

horizon:survey_plate.name: Survey Plate
tip: Pressed by a Mechanical Press. Proof that your line runs.

recipes.why: A replacement charter costs ordinary early materials; progress lives in the ledger, not the block.
Cheap; the proof is the pressing step.
The only source of Survey Plates.
Displays a find; the shard is the 'discovery' it holds, so the case is an exploration sink, not a relic source.
The one late relic gate of the campaign: one heart, once.
